nested-classes-basics.title: Nested classes
nested-classes-basics.short: Declare a class inside another class
nested-classes-basics.summary: Use nested classes to keep closely related types together.
nested-classes-basics.why: A nested class can express implementation structure without adding another top-level type to the package namespace.
nested-classes-basics.tips: Use a static nested class when it does not need an enclosing instance; non-static inner classes retain one.

pattern-switch-basics.title: Pattern matching in switch
pattern-switch-basics.summary: Use type patterns directly in switch cases.
pattern-switch-basics.why: Pattern switches combine type testing, binding, and branching without a chain of instanceof checks and casts.
pattern-switch-basics.tips: Keep cases exhaustive where required and order guarded or specific cases so their intent stays clear.

map-merge-counter.title: Count values with Map.merge
map-merge-counter.short: Update a map entry with a combining function
map-merge-counter.summary: Use Map.merge for compact counters and accumulators.
map-merge-counter.why: merge handles the absent-key and existing-key cases in one operation, avoiding repetitive contains/get/put code.
map-merge-counter.tips: The remapping function can remove an entry by returning null, so account for that when null has meaning in the design.

string-strip.title: Strip surrounding whitespace
string-strip.summary: Use strip when surrounding Unicode whitespace should be removed.
string-strip.why: Unlike trim, strip uses the Unicode-aware definition of whitespace and is usually a better fit for human text.
string-strip.tips: strip does not modify the original String because strings are immutable.

input-mismatch-exception.title: InputMismatchException
input-mismatch-exception.short: Scanner input does not match the requested type
input-mismatch-exception.summary: Handle Scanner input that cannot be converted to the requested token type.
input-mismatch-exception.why: Methods such as nextInt throw InputMismatchException when the next token exists but does not match the expected format.
input-mismatch-exception.tips: For interactive input, check hasNextInt or read text first and validate it explicitly.

no-such-file-exception.title: NoSuchFileException
no-such-file-exception.short: A requested filesystem path does not exist
no-such-file-exception.summary: Handle missing paths reported by NIO file operations.
no-such-file-exception.why: Files operations commonly report a missing file with NoSuchFileException, a more specific IOException subtype.
no-such-file-exception.tips: Do not rely on an exists check for correctness when another process can change the filesystem between checking and opening.

duplicate-case-label.title: Duplicate case label
duplicate-case-label.short: Each switch label must be unique
duplicate-case-label.summary: Remove duplicate constant labels from a switch.
duplicate-case-label.why: Two case labels with the same constant value would make one branch indistinguishable from the other, so Java rejects them at compile time.
duplicate-case-label.tips: When constants are expressions, remember that different-looking expressions may still have the same compile-time value.

abstract-method-not-implemented.title: Abstract method not implemented
abstract-method-not-implemented.short: A concrete class must implement required methods
abstract-method-not-implemented.summary: Implement all inherited abstract interface or class methods.
abstract-method-not-implemented.why: A non-abstract class must provide implementations for every abstract method it inherits.
abstract-method-not-implemented.tips: Check the exact signature and visibility; a nearly matching method may fail to override the required declaration.

unchecked-method-invocation-warning.title: Unchecked method invocation warning
unchecked-method-invocation-warning.short: A raw value weakens a generic method call
unchecked-method-invocation-warning.summary: Preserve generic type information when invoking parameterized APIs.
unchecked-method-invocation-warning.why: Passing a raw generic value can prevent the compiler from proving that a parameterized method call is type safe.
unchecked-method-invocation-warning.tips: Parameterize collections at their creation point instead of suppressing the warning downstream.

nan-equality-check.title: Comparing with NaN using ==
nan-equality-check.short: Use Double.isNaN to test for NaN
nan-equality-check.summary: Test floating-point NaN with the dedicated predicate.
nan-equality-check.why: IEEE floating-point rules make NaN unequal to every value, including itself, so value == Double.NaN is always false.
nan-equality-check.tips: Use Double.isNaN or Float.isNaN and consider how NaN should propagate through later calculations.
